notes.witness_rule_applied: Same o. Outcomes opposite: PERFORMED on one side, REFUSED or NOT-IN-FORCE on the other. The events differ in exactly one of r,a,k,s,t,e,x,h,c. The variable is one of a,k,s,t,e,c,h. UNK is compared literally as a value.
